entries.1c5f6c41463f6961: As a consistent basic policy, it aims to contribute to society through valves, with the goal of diverse development of applications for high-pressure gas-related equipment, while keeping in mind the maintenance of a sound quality control system to meet customers' trust. The fiscal year ended December 2025, the final year of the 5-year '2026 Medium-Term Management Plan', which sets the basic strategies for achieving 'Vision 2030', focuses on 4 priority issues: existing business strategy, clean energy strategy, new overseas business strategy and developing a structure for the future. In light of the cease-and-desist order and surcharge payment order that the company received from the Japan Fair Trade Commission in June 2024 for violating the Antimonopoly Act, it is promoting organizational and awareness reforms, including the establishment of a Compliance Promotion Office.
